questions.q: What dataset does this lab load, and from where?
options: Cybersyn's consumer company metadata, from a real public S3 bucket
A fabricated sample CSV created just for this course
A dataset generated randomly by a SQL script
Data exported from an SSMS demo database
questions.explain: The lab uses the same real, publicly-accessible dataset and bucket as Snowflake's own Getting Started with Snowflake quickstart.

questions.q: What is the purpose of running LIST @stage before COPY INTO in this lab?
options: To confirm the stage actually sees real files before attempting to load anything
To delete files from the stage before loading
To automatically create the target table
To change the file format used by the stage
questions.explain: LIST @stage is a sanity check — proof the stage's connection to the bucket actually works and returns real files.

questions.q: In the COPY INTO result set, what does it mean if rows_parsed and rows_loaded don't match for a file?
options: ON_ERROR handling skipped some rows — worth checking the first_error column before assuming it's fine
The file was loaded twice
The stage has been deleted
The file format was applied to the wrong table
questions.explain: A mismatch between parsed and loaded row counts, under ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE', usually means some rows failed and were skipped rather than aborting the whole load.

questions.q: What should happen if you run the exact same COPY INTO statement a second time in this lab?
options: It reports the files as already loaded and loads zero additional rows
It doubles the row count in the table
It throws a fatal error and stops
It automatically deletes the previously loaded rows
questions.explain: This demonstrates Snowflake's load metadata (Lesson 14) working against a real file set: already-loaded files are skipped automatically.

questions.q: Which four lessons' concepts does this lab explicitly tie together?
options: Lesson 12 (stages), Lesson 13 (file formats), Lesson 14 (COPY INTO), and Lesson 16 (error handling)
Lesson 1, Lesson 2, Lesson 3, and Lesson 4
Only Lesson 14, repeated four times
Lessons from Chapter 4 exclusively
questions.explain: The lab's guide explicitly maps each SQL step back to the lesson it came from: stage (12), file format (13), COPY INTO (14), and ON_ERROR handling (16).
